name: VideoPlayerLifecycleManager
src_typeComment: Wraps a VideoPlayer to enforce a clean prepare -> play -> stop -> release cycle instead of leaving a previous clip's decoder resources and RenderTexture allocated indefinitely between plays — the second half of this session's answer to "too many assets, and videos" memory growth on a long-running kiosk. Owns its own single-clip looping (via re-calling PlayClip on loopPointReached) rather than the VideoPlayer's native isLooping, specifically so every loop iteration goes through the same clean stop-and-release path instead of silently keeping the same decoder session alive forever.

src_serialized.name: loopSingleClip
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, automatically replays the same clip when it finishes — a simple attract-mode loop. Set false if you're managing looping/playlists yourself.

src_members.name: PlayClip
src_members.comment: Stops and releases whatever was previously playing (if anything) before preparing the new clip.
